description: This file contains extension methods for the GrainId class, providing functionality to create and parse keys (integer, GUID, with optional extension) for grains within the Orleans framework. It includes methods for generating IdSpan representations of keys, parsing grain IDs to extract keys, and managing key extensions.

classes.name: GrainIdKeyExtensions
classes.description: Provides static extension methods for handling GrainId keys, including creation from and parsing to long and Guid types with optional extensions.

methods.name: CreateIntegerKey
methods.description: Creates an IdSpan representing a long integer key.

methods.name: CreateIntegerKey
methods.description: Creates an IdSpan representing a long integer key with a UTF-8 string extension.

methods.name: CreateIntegerKey
methods.description: Creates an IdSpan representing a long integer key with a string extension.

methods.name: CreateGuidKey
methods.description: Creates an IdSpan representing a Guid key.

methods.name: CreateGuidKey
methods.description: Creates an IdSpan representing a Guid key with a UTF-8 string extension.

methods.name: CreateGuidKey
methods.description: Creates an IdSpan representing a Guid key with a string extension.

methods.name: TryGetIntegerKey
methods.description: Attempts to parse the GrainId's Key as a long integer and an extension string.

methods.name: TryGetIntegerKey
methods.description: Internal method to try parsing the GrainId's Key as a long integer.

methods.name: GetIntegerKey
methods.description: Returns the integer key from a GrainId, throwing if invalid.

methods.name: GetIntegerKey
methods.description: Overload returning the integer key from a GrainId.

methods.name: TryGetGuidKey
methods.description: Attempts to parse the GrainId's Key as a Guid and extension string.

methods.name: TryGetGuidKey
methods.description: Internal method to try parsing the GrainId's Key as a Guid.

methods.name: GetGuidKey
methods.description: Returns the Guid key from a GrainId, throwing if invalid.

methods.name: GetGuidKey
methods.description: Overload returning the Guid key from a GrainId.
